title: Gemini 4 Carbon is now available for developers.
gist: Google released Gemini 4 Carbon to developers, calling it its strongest model with frontier cybersecurity and long-horizon agentic capabilities; access is via the paid Gemini API tier in Google AI Studio and Android Studio, and for Google AI Ultra subscribers in AI Studio and Google Antigravity.

insights.claim: Google made Gemini 4 Carbon available to developers on Nov 10, 2026, describing it as its strongest model with frontier performance in cybersecurity and long-horizon capabilities.
insights.speaker: Google AI Blog
insights.so_what: Frontier-model race continues; cybersecurity is now a headline capability axis for Google's flagship.
insights.quote: our strongest model with frontier performance in cybersecurity and long-horizon capabilities

insights.claim: Gemini 4 Carbon is built for sustained agentic workflows, targeting complex multi-step problems in software engineering, full-stack web development and scientific research, with Google citing stronger alignment and reliable follow-through.
insights.speaker: Google AI Blog
insights.so_what: Long-horizon coding agents are the key competitive battleground among frontier labs.

insights.claim: Gemini 4 Carbon is offered through the paid tier of the Gemini API in Google AI Studio and Android Studio, while Google AI Ultra subscribers can try it in AI Studio and the agent-first development platform Google Antigravity.
insights.speaker: Google AI Blog
insights.so_what: Paid-tier-only gating signals Google monetizing its top model via API and premium subscriptions, and pushing its own agentic IDE (Antigravity).
insights.locator: Start building using the paid tier
